key_insight: PMC-PaIR uses citation-linked case reports and question-guided language models to build clinically similar image pairs that improve medical image retrieval.
clinical_relevance: Retrieving images with similar clinical findings could support teaching, research and diagnostic reference, but clinical benefit was not established.
method: Follow citations between open-access case reports to identify potentially similar patients.
Use hierarchical language-model questions about modality, diagnosis and findings to match images through their captions.
Fine-tune BiomedCLIP on the resulting image pairs and evaluate retrieval.
evidence_signal: The dataset contains 86,144 image pairs from 56,013 case reports; experts rated pairs highly accurate, question-guided matching yielded twice as many correct pairs as direct matching, and fine-tuning improved retrieval across all tested categories.
watch_item: Case reports often emphasize rare or challenging presentations, so performance may not generalize to routine clinical imaging.
paper_title: A dataset of clinically similar image pairs from citation-linked case reports for medical image retrieval
